text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Fine Motion wasn't feeling well, I 
decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry. I'm going to rest for a 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...? Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
Kukukuk... Have you awakened, Princess...? 
I am the Demon King...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Demon King? I see. What business might 
you have with me?"

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
You are my hostage! Now the 
Umamusume-Trainer coalition can't make a 
careless move... Watch the world crumble 
right from the best seat in the house!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—If you truly claim to be a king, then 
open your eyes and look at your 
surroundings."

text_block_list.name: Demon Child
text_block_list.text:
"Mommy, the crops aren't growin' at all. 
Why is this happenin'...?"

text_block_list.name: Demon Mother
text_block_list.text:
"The soil here is barren, you see... No 
matter what you try to grow, it just 
doesn't turn out well."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To wage war on another nation, and even 
seek its destruction, all while neglecting 
the suffering of one's own people—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You must not avert your eyes from the 
country you love!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: U-Uguh!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if you have a mind to change, 
I will gladly lend you the knowledge I 
have acquired."

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: K-Knowledge...? What's that...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Japanese rice farming!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ooooh...? The green, it's so 
blinding...!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once cooked, you can grill it or boil it. 
Though it's a bit different, mochi is also 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If we nurture it until autumn, this place 
will turn into an irreplaceable, golden 
treasure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I've kind of gotten hungry. I'll eat a 
good meal and head back♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to getting plenty of rest, Fine 
Motion seemed to be feeling all better!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Japanese ramen!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Ra... men?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't know? In that case, let me 
teach you from square one♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ramen uses wheat flour as its main 
ingredient, but by mixing in a substance 
called kansui...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I rambled on for way too long~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion talked too passionately in her 
dream, and felt like she hardly got any 
rest at all...
